scientific_integrity: Finite exact-rational checks are ancillary; the universal conclusion is proved analytically using winding number and metric bounds.
scientific_limitations: Uniform generator residual is controlled only on two true periodic orbits, not on finite training sets or unspecified probability-weighted losses.
Requires an anchored global C1 diffeomorphism with positive known bi-Lipschitz lower constant; degenerating or noninvertible transformations are excluded.
Coefficient optimality is proved for equal upper and lower metric constants; dependence on arbitrary non-unit condition ratios need not be sharp.
The literature comparison is bounded by available primary texts and semantic searches; historical novelty is not independently certified.
title: A sharp two-orbit frequency-mismatch floor for conditioned planar flow conjugacies
